preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between n-1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi and 1 <= ci <= 10000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect distinct vertices within the range and have a flow volume between 1 and 10,000.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if ai == v) == sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if bi == v) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of incoming flow equals the sum of outgoing flow.

postconditions.expression: all(ai != 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
postconditions.description: Vertex 1 must have no incoming edges.

postconditions.expression: len(set((ai, bi) for ai, bi, ci in edges)) == m
postconditions.description: The directed graph must not have cycles and must contain exactly m edges.
